jobs.title: IT Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description: Nordic Investin is recruiting an IT Service Delivery Manager on behalf of one of our partner companies. You know that dependable IT service comes from clear ownership, capable teams and honest performance data. The partner needs a service delivery leader for business critical workplace and infrastructure services. You will manage performance, suppliers and continual improvement while keeping the experience of employees and business teams visible. The work spans organisational boundaries and requires both technical understanding and disciplined communication. Decisions must remain useful when they reach delivery teams, suppliers and operational owners. How you will work You will work across teams with different incentives, technical histories and decision rights. The partner expects concise preparation, visible dependencies and follow through after meetings. Strong performance means that people understand what was decided, why it matters and what they now own. As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work. What you will do Own service performance, reviews and improvement plans. Coordinate internal teams and external service providers. Manage major incident communication and follow up. Improve service levels, measures and operational reporting. Oversee change, capacity, continuity and lifecycle risks. Build trusted relationships with business service owners. What you will bring Senior IT service delivery or operations management experience. Strong ITIL knowledge applied pragmatically. Supplier, SLA and commercial management ability. Experience leading major incident and problem management. Clear reporting and stakeholder communication. Professional English; Swedish may be required for local operations. Experience that would add value Workplace, network or cloud service responsibility. Service transition after outsourcing or transformation. Experience managing distributed or international delivery. A background that can succeed here You may have progressed through infrastructure operations, service management, supplier governance or technical support leadership. The partner values leaders who can discuss service evidence in detail and still keep attention on the people affected. What makes the opportunity interesting You will have the mandate to improve how services are run rather than only report their status. The role offers broad relationships, visible operational outcomes and meaningful influence over suppliers and future service design. The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time. The recruitment conversation During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap. How to apply Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.company: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Job Description H&M is continuing to shape the future of digital commerce by creating stable, connected, and customer-focused experiences across our global digital landscape. Within Digital Transaction, we are strengthening our end-to-end technical coordination across key customer journeys such as login, cart, checkout, payment, order management, and returns. We are now looking for a Service Delivery Manager to help safeguard end-to-end technical coherence, integration integrity, and operational readiness across the Digital Transaction area. This role supports the Area Tech Manager by ensuring that independently accountable product teams collectively deliver a stable, resilient, and customer-safe end-to-end solution. This is not a governance layer. It is a coordinating and enabling role focused on transparency, early risk visibility, and technical alignment across teams, products, platforms, and external vendor integrations. WHAT YOU’LL DO Maintain a holistic end-to-end technical view across the Digital Transaction customer journey. Continuously update and communicate the E2E integration landscape across products and components. Identify cross-component risks, integration breakpoints, and architectural drift before they impact customers. Safeguard critical customer journeys, including login, cart, checkout, payment, order management, and returns. Ensure integration sequencing, dependency transparency, and API contract discipline across teams and vendors. Support coordinated E2E go-live readiness for multi-component releases. Validate E2E test readiness, deployment coordination, and operational preparedness across product areas. Ensure observability, traceability, resilience, and error handling consistency across the full customer journey. Surface technical debt and structural misalignment that may impact customer-facing stability. Support incident analysis by helping teams treat issues as end-to-end journey concerns rather than isolated product failures. Provide the Area Tech Manager with clear E2E risk visibility, early escalation points, and proactive recommendations. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will work closely with the Area Tech Manager, Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Operations, Program Managers, and multiple product teams across the Digital Transaction area. You will play an important role in connecting technical perspectives across teams and making sure that dependencies, risks, and customer impact are visible early. You will support alignment across independently accountable teams without taking over their mandate or decision authority. We are looking for someone who enjoys collaboration, complexity, and problem-solving across teams. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where technical coordination, clear communication, and proactive risk management are key to delivering stable customer experiences. WHO YOU ARE You have solid experience working in complex digital, ecommerce, platform, or transaction-heavy technology environments. You understand end-to-end customer journeys and how technical dependencies across systems can impact customer experience. You have experience coordinating technical delivery, integration readiness, or operational readiness across multiple teams. You have strong knowledge of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, and cloud-based architectures. You understand observability, monitoring, tracing, error handling, resilience, and production stability. You are experienced in identifying cross-team dependencies, integration risks, and technical gaps. You can translate complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders. You are comfortable working with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, Product Managers, Operations, and Program Managers. You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
